name: Ethereum mainnet
notes: Proof-of-stake L1 with a competitive block-builder market (MEV-Boost). Arbitrage txs normally reach a builder as a private bundle and pay the builder directly, so realised profit = gross spread - swap fees - gas - builder payment. There is no l1Fee component.

rpcCapabilities.measuredBy: scripts/20-enumeration-probe.mjs, 2026-10-29. An unfiltered eth_getLogs is served for exactly one block and refused beyond it ('Please specify an address in your request'), against 100 blocks on Base. A 12-second block time partly compensates: one block here is six blocks of Base chain time.

pancake-v3.label: PancakeSwap V3
pancake-v3.evidence: Found by scripts/23-identify-factories.mjs: 2,188 swaps in the sweep window, feeAmountTickSpacing() present. The address is byte-identical to the factory already identified as PancakeSwap V3 on Base, which is how the brand is attributed; the family is established from the fingerprint alone.

sushi-v3.label: SushiSwap V3
sushi-v3.evidence: Found by scripts/23-identify-factories.mjs: feeAmountTickSpacing(3000)=60, the Uniswap V3 value, so it is a straight V3 fork. 553 swaps in the sweep window. Brand attribution from the documented SushiV3Factory address; the family is from chain state.

aero-merged-cl-eth.label: Aero/Velodrome Slipstream CL (Ethereum deployment)
aero-merged-cl-eth.evidence: Slipstream fingerprint (poolImplementation/voter/factoryRegistry) with voter()=0x382409fad8503FbCdbB27A4211551fa03e884078 — the SAME voter as the Base factory configured here as aero-merged-cl, so it is the same protocol deployed on Ethereum. 1,294 swaps in the sweep window.

unidentified-v2-a-eth.label: Unidentified Uniswap V2 fork A
unidentified-v2-a-eth.evidence: V2-style factory, allPairsLength()=468, 1,611 swaps in the sweep window. Brand not identified. feeBps assumed to be the V2 default of 30 and NOT verified on-chain, so quotes from this venue carry that assumption.

unidentified-v2-b-eth.evidence: V2-style factory, allPairsLength()=8094. Brand not identified. feeBps assumed to be the V2 default of 30 and NOT verified on-chain.
